offering_description.value: The company engineers and precision-manufactures components and systems for aerospace, defense, and industrial customers. It provides electric utilities with grid diagnostic equipment, software, and services. It also supplies RF measurement and control systems for electronics, healthcare, and other markets.

quotes.quote: ESCO Technologies is a global provider of highly-engineered products and solutions to diverse and growing end-markets that include the defense, aerospace, wireless, consumer electronics, healthcare, automotive, electric utility, and renewable energy industries. The company consists of three technology-driven business segments – Aerospace & Defense, Utility Solutions Group, and RF Test & Measurement.
ESCO Technologies consists of three business segments dedicated to solving difficult technical challenges through superior engineering, precision manufacturing, and world class customer service.

primary_products.value: hydraulic filtration systems; precision fluid control valves; machined aerospace components and naval vibration-control tiles; grid diagnostic equipment and software; RF measurement, control, and shielding components and systems

quotes.quote: Our Aerospace & Defense (A&D) companies provide highly-engineered hydraulic filtration systems, precision fluid control valves, machined components, and specialized metal finishing for aerospace applications. A&D also designs and manufactures complex shock and vibration dampening tiles, as well as signature and power management solutions that enhance the stealth capabilities of U.S. & U.K. Navy submarines and surface ships.

Our RF Test & Measurement (Test) business is a leading provider of electromagnetic components and systems that measure and control RF energy for research and development, regulatory compliance, medical shielding, EMP protection, and security applications.
